subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ACCIDENT' is written as 'JDDBUOFE', 'ABSOLUTE' is written as 'PTCBFUVM', and 'ACCURATE' is written as 'VDDBFUBS'. How will 'SENTENCE' be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] The logic followed here is: 'ACCIDENT' is written as 'JDDBUOFE' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53e77e32d52315079b98fb37182330805a877d9aff8860822a9a71132e4884d0.png] 'ABSOLUTE' is written as 'PTCBFUVM'
